plate_comment: While the final fueling state is FUELING_STATE_COOLANT_OVERHEAT_DERATE: on entry (the previous state at 0x3fcdc4 was not 46) coolant_overheat_derate_minimum_injection_timing starts at main_injection_timing, then rises toward the engine speed table (coolant_overheat_derate_minimum_injection_timing_values) by at most coolant_overheat_derate_minimum_injection_timing_step per pass; outside the derate it falls by the step to -1024 (no minimum). cm848_calculateMainInjectionTiming keeps the main timing at or above it (was governor_injectionTiming_modeAdj)
